END GOAL

WEEK 1
DAY Monday recovery 20m "Gentle mobility and breathing"
WARMUP
marching 2m
END WARMUP
MAIN mobility
cat_cow 8 reps
pelvic_tilt 10 reps
diaphragmatic_breathing 10 reps
child_pose 30 seconds
END MAIN
COOLDOWN
chest_stretch 30 seconds
shoulder_stretch 30 seconds

WARMUP
marching 2m

MAIN cardio

hip_flexor_stretch 30 seconds
quad_stretch 30 seconds

MAIN mobility
pelvic_tilt 10 reps
bird_dog 5 reps each side rpe 2
dead_bug 5 reps rpe 2

back_stretch 30 seconds
spinal_twist 30 seconds each side

WARMUP
